packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time member-login/member-home shell renders with black/yellow One Time branding and a closed helper by default on desktop and mobile without changing member login, forms, support/question APIs, redirects, auth, route access, or external-provider behavior.

title: Member Login Brand And Helper Readability Cleanup

reasons: Latest mobile screenshot for the legacy member-login alias shows the One Time member shell using a large BNA Academy hero mark instead of One Time black/yellow branding.
The member helper appears open in the full-page mobile audit screenshot even before the user asks for help.
The fix can be scoped to the member shell and shared helper closed-state behavior without changing member auth, forms, APIs, route access, sends, payments, or external providers.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Real member login sends, access grants, payments, question sends, support routing, connector tests, and external writes are out of scope.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this member-login cleanup, continue screenshot-reviewed brand/IA cleanup for member library/classroom or CRM contact-detail polish.

operator_intent_summary: Make the One Time member-login/member-home page feel clean and correctly branded by removing BNA logo/palette bleed and keeping the helper out of the loaded screenshot until requested.

decisions_captured.decision: Production deploy/live-smoke target is still required before terminal app-visible Done.

out_of_scope: No member login API, dry-run preview-login behavior, member session token, support ticket API, private question API, library API, live-session API, account/logout behavior, redirect behavior, route registry, auth, entitlement, payment, access grant, send, or external-provider behavior change.
No email, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Stripe/payment, Drive, Vimeo, Zoom, DNS, account mutation, upload, publish, or external CRM write.
No GHL runtime or LeadConnector reference.
No raw private member, parent, student, provider, support, question, session, token, secret, or contact evidence.

inspection_targets: public/rabbi-member.html inline member shell styles and nav/header markup
public/js/bna-bot-widget.js One Time member surface config and closed panel state
known_blockers: Production deploy/live-smoke remains blocked until a target is explicit.
observed_visual_defects: The member shell uses the BNA social preview image in its hero instead of One Time brand imagery.
The member shell uses cream/green/blue/gold colors instead of the authoritative One Time black/yellow palette.
The helper title says BNA Helper on a One Time member surface.
The helper panel is visible in the full-page mobile audit screenshot before the user opens Assistant/help.

expanded_phrases.clean: The member-login/member-home page should immediately look like a One Time member surface, not a BNA Academy placeholder.
expanded_phrases.even: Navigation, hero, cards, forms, helper launcher, and helper panel should share One Time black/yellow colors, spacing, readable contrast, and closed/open states.
expanded_phrases.loads nicely: The first desktop/mobile screenshot should show the member login form and member modules without an offscreen/closed helper panel occupying the capture.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: The route remains a first-party One Time member portal shell scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.

requirements.statement: Fix the One Time member-login/member-home shell so it uses the One Time black/yellow brand and keeps the helper closed until explicitly opened.
requirements.expected_result: Desktop and mobile screenshots show One Time logo/black/yellow styling, readable login/support/question cards, no BNA Academy hero/logo bleed, and no visible helper panel until Assistant/help or the launcher is activated.
acceptance_criteria: The member shell uses One Time brand assets and black/yellow/white/muted colors instead of BNA social preview/green/blue/cream styling.
The member top navigation, hero, panels, cards, badges, inputs, and primary actions remain readable on desktop and mobile.
The helper launcher/title on One Time member surfaces is branded as One Time helper, while permissions/scope copy remains unchanged.
The shared helper panel is hidden/inert while closed and becomes visible only after Assistant/help or launcher activation.
Legacy aliases `/one-time/member-login`, `/member`, and `/member-portal` keep redirecting to `/rabbi-member`.
Member login, logout, private question, support ticket, library, live-session, auth, route access, API, and external-provider behavior remain unchanged.

criteria: Raw source and broad UI cleanup register exist for RAW-20260702-008.
Brand memory and design reference confirm One Time is black/yellow and must not use BNA cream/navy/teal/cyan/academy brand as its surface identity.
Current screenshots show member-login BNA hero/logo bleed and helper panel visibility in mobile full-page capture.
The likely fix is scoped to member shell markup/CSS plus shared helper closed-state and One Time member helper label.
No member data, auth, send, payment, access, connector, credential, privacy, legal, or financial decision is required for local visual implementation.
